description: Merges four vMIDI streams into one and splits the result by message type

inputs.text: One of the four vMIDI streams merged into the outputs

outputs.text: Carries the channel messages from all four inputs: notes, controllers, program changes, pressure and pitch bend
Carries the system messages from all four inputs: timing clock, start, continue, stop, song position and the rest
Carries every message from all four inputs, channel and system alike

notes: system exclusive is not passed at all; the maker's code leaves it unwritten
the inputs are read in numerical order within each pass, so when messages arrive together the one on the lowest-numbered input goes out first
